title: Very Bad Optimisation
body:
I have tried this app again and again since it seems to be the only app with such good features.

But oh god its so bad when you use it. 

Syncing does not work
Half the tasks dont show in widget
Sometimes when you create tasks they just disappear
App crashes randomly
Check ins dont save
Reminders dont work as they should

And many more bugs

They have good designers
But really bad developers 

Another example of looks great, doesnt work

I have tried the app on iphone 7 plus, iphone 8 and iphone X and all the issues persist to some extent all the way from ios 11 to the current ios 12.0.1

So yeah I am never installing this app again

If you want to use it, don’t buy it, just make do with the free features.
